evidence: Has the Wallet label, modifies wallet rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp, and updates wallet_resendwallettransactions.py.
rationale: Fixes a wallet privacy leak where periodic transaction rebroadcasts unconditionally relay transactions already resident in the local mempool. As noted in the description citing issue #36403, redundant rebroadcasts leak user IP and transaction ownership by signaling to peers that the node has special interest in those transactions.
